approval.note: Lead review: matches ADR-0035 and the amended spec. toolchain tables are validated against the known set, profile warns once, and init writes the table. run.py changes one docstring only (the sensitive-path flag); the large-change flag is the nine test fixtures losing their profile line. 405 tests pass.

reviews.summary: The change implements the ADR-0035 component toolchain declaration: it retires the profile label, adds aios/toolchains.py with version parsing/minimum checks, updates config parsing to validate optional toolchain tables and warn on retired profile entries, changes init to detect and emit toolchain tables instead of --profile, updates fixtures/tests accordingly, and makes the specified run.py docstring amendment. Tests pass and the acceptance criteria are met based on the provided check output.
